description: This file contains a PHP class 'Report' which extends the OpenCart system controller for handling extension reports in the admin area. It includes methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling report extensions, and dynamically loads reports based on the existing files and database entries.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Controller class for managing report extensions in the OpenCart administrative interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that outputs the list of reports.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available report extensions, their status, and prepares data for the view, including registering respective controllers and resources.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process for a report extension, including language loading, database updates, and permission assignments.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process for a report extension, including language loading, database cleanup, and permission adjustments.
